label: tp-driver-extreme-10y
_why: STAGE 1b OF THE TREATY-PORT PROBES (overnight, user-authorised to try approaches). Stage 1 (20261018_231810, the admin-strategy desire at +400) showed the engine reads the desire but pursues treaty ports ONLY against unrecognised or decentralised hosts: 14 AI pairs wanted one at 1846 (0 in vanilla 1845-46 saves), none recognised, though the diagnostic 20261018_234440 measured desires of 400+ for recognised hosts whose states pass is_potential_treaty_port. This book adds the DRIVER: once a year every eligible AI (recognised, major power or above, at peace, in no committed play, permitted aggressive plays, not infamous, off a 2-year cooldown) starts a dp_take_treaty_port play on the recognised-host state where its engine-computed desire is highest (EXTREME: chance 100%, any positive desire).

_arms.tpxd: {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.jex-dam4s-rs-x25-m10ac-dpriv-wm99-tpxd.json} - the next-arm book + the extreme desire + the extreme driver; + telemetry

_comparison: Against stage 1 (admin desire alone, same extreme values): 0-1 treaty-port goals a snapshot, 1 new port in 2 runs.

_predictions.if the driver works: PMR_TPD lines in debug.log from 1837 for many AIs; treaty-port goals (take_treaty_port or enforce_treaty_article:treaty_port) against RECOGNISED hosts in most snapshots; new treaty ports in recognised hosts by 1846
_predictions.if create_diplomatic_play fails: PMR_TPD lines but no plays: error.log names the play type or target
_predictions.the parity cancel: no driven play against a host within 5 technologies (the desire is negative there, below min_value)

_stop_rule: none: two fixed runs (a mechanism probe, read in full).
_caveats: EXTREME values: the economy and the wars of these runs are not a balance reading of anything.
The observer's autosaves overwrite the user's autosave slots: save games BACKUP 20261018_2317 holds the originals.
